product_metadata.title: Warmwithann Set of 2, 16 x 16 Inches Cotton Fabric Square Pillow Inserts, Down and Feather Decorative Throw Pillows Inserts
features: Please NOTE your pillow insert must be Larger than your sham to correctly fill the corners of the sham and give them a nice full and fluffy look. This 16"x16" inch pillow insert is recommended for use in a 14"x14" inch sham. This price includes two cotton fabric pillow inserts, the size is 16 x 16 inches. The size are measured from seam to seam.
These soft down and feather decorative throw pillow inserts provide cozy and firm support when you're in a seated position. For use with all types of shams & covers.
These cotton fabric throw pillow inserts are more durable than polyester fabric.
These decorative throw pillow inserts are filled with down and feather.
Easy to clean and dry: Machine washable, in gentle cycle with cold water and hang it up to dry.
